properties.name: GMBA v2 Standard mountain terrain for Pacific Northwest and California support

source.dataset: GMBA Mountain Inventory v2 Standard Basic — hiking terrain

properties.attribution: Derived from GMBA Mountain Inventory v2, Snethlage et al. (2022), GMBA-EarthEnv. Clipped, dissolved and coordinate-quantized by Alpine Loop; no endorsement implied.
properties.datasetCitation: Snethlage, M. A. et al. (2022). GMBA Mountain Inventory v2. GMBA-EarthEnv. https://doi.org/10.48601/earthenv-t9k2-1407
properties.paperCitation: Snethlage, M. A. et al. (2022). A hierarchical inventory of the world’s mountains for global comparative mountain science. Scientific Data 9, 149. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01256-y

derivation.method: Intersect all source polygons with the union of the listed WGS84 rectangles; dissolve all intersections; quantize coordinates; normalize ordering and orient exterior rings counterclockwise and holes clockwise.
derivation.repair: none; all 290 selected source records and the dissolved geometry were valid

limitations: Standard delineates GMBA mountain terrain, not every low foothill or worthwhile hiking landscape; low-relief approaches can be absent.
The source is a regional terrain inventory, not a trail-scale terrain survey. Coordinate precision does not establish source boundary accuracy.
Only the two listed support envelopes are represented. This is not statewide California or a global terrain mask.
Terrain membership does not establish legal access, a mapped trail, an entrance, current conditions, or region ownership. Regional coverage and exact exclusions remain independent.
No buffers, hole fills, minimum-area filtering or terrain thresholds were added. Included valleys and support polygons remain as supplied by the inventory.
